selection_basis: Chosen using existing r3 traces to exercise result checks, mapping repair overhead, unsupported hard bounds and metric comparability. Includes adverse prior M example. Selection is not blind and cannot estimate generalization.
metrics: actual sample attempts and candidates, remaining budget
prepare_plan call count, ready/blocked and issue codes
check_candidates invoked, checks_performed, valid/unique counts and requirement statuses
compare_candidate_metrics invoked, comparable and method identities
API requests/accounted CNY, wall seconds, tool calls and clarification count

task_observables.D0101: Check actual candidate c_c failure, valid/unique counts and unknown research goal; when evidence disabled report null/no checks, not a made-up error.
task_observables.D0201: Inspect normalized 1.2 eV target, prepare retries/blocked codes, actual sampling and unchanged budget; retain mapping overhead.
task_observables.D0202: Inspect hard lower-bound handling, execute calls and all blocking reasons. Adapter input rejection may survive mapping ablation; do not attribute all blocking to mapping.
task_observables.D0502: Inspect comparator calls, false vs unknown, metric IDs/method identities and visible final wording. LLM may correctly refuse comparison without program checks.

stop_rules: Run exactly these planned rows once, retaining every failure. No rerun to improve scores.
Stop batch if runner quarantine, shared fixture/source integrity failure or unintended real computation is detected.
No additional task/model/LLM expansion merely to hide neutral or negative findings.
No formal correct-task rate or human speedup claims without subsequent user review and appropriately designed measurement.
note: Exact runtime/source hashes will be bound in a separate launch receipt before creating start.json; this file remains unchanged.
